description: This Kotlin source file defines the core authentication/session manager class 'AuthManager' for an Android application. It manages in-memory auth state, token persistence, login, lock/unlock, logout, and token refresh procedures, providing a ViewModel/UI API. The file references multiple models related to authentication and session management, and abstracts network operations via lambdas. It also contains factory methods for production and testing setups.

classes.name: AuthManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing authentication state, including login, logout, locking, unlocking, and token refresh logic. It interacts with token storage and session repository, supports initialization from persistent storage, and provides a coroutine-based API for authentication operations.

methods.name: authStateFlow
methods.description: Returns a Flow stream of authentication state changes.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current authentication state snapshot.

methods.name: initializeFromStorage
methods.description: Loads persisted tokens on app startup; initializes session state accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by exchanging credentials for tokens, then persists tokens and updates session state.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the current session, keeping tokens in storage but setting state to locked.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks an existing session after successful user verification.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens from storage and sets session state to logged out.

methods.name: getAccessTokenIfUnlocked
methods.description: Retrieves the access token if the session is unlocked.

methods.name: ensureFreshAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures a valid, non-expired access token; refreshes if necessary.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate AuthManager with default dependencies for production.

methods.name: createForTesting
methods.description: Factory method for injecting custom dependencies for testing purposes.
